达到。低浓度阿托品滴眼液 SYD-101 在儿童近视中减少了快速进展的比例，p=: Met. Low-dose atropine eye drops SYD-101 reduced the share of children with rapidly progressing myopia, p=0.023. A moderate effect; another entrant in the low-dose atropine race, differentiated mainly by formulation stability.
达到。周制剂胰岛素 icodec 从每日基础胰岛素转换，HbA1c 比甘精胰岛素: Met. Switching from daily basal insulin to weekly insulin icodec lowered HbA1c 0.2 points more than glargine. The main advantage is dosing frequency; hypoglycaemia risk should be read alongside the data.

达到。瑞美吉泮在中国人群偏头痛预防中，每月偏头痛天数比安慰剂多减少约 1 天。效: Met. Rimegepant for migraine prevention in Chinese patients reduced monthly migraine days about 1 day more than placebo. The effect matches global trials, supporting a prevention filing in China.

A moderate effect; mechanistically it improves sleep and mood together, suited to the insomnia subgroup.
达到。鲁美哌隆在精神分裂症维持治疗中把复发风险降低约 63%（HR 0.37）。: Met. Lumateperone cut relapse risk in schizophrenia maintenance by about 63% (HR 0.37). Randomised-withdrawal designs make positive results easier, but the effect size and safety support it as a maintenance option.

The first time an oral PCSK9 inhibitor reached this reduction in phase 3; the key next step is the cardiovascular outcomes trial.

非共价 BTK 抑制剂匹妥布替尼在初治 CLL 中，PFS 风险降低 80%，客: The non-covalent BTK inhibitor pirtobrutinib cut the risk of progression by 80% in treatment-naive CLL, with an objective response rate of 94% vs 81%. The FDA approved the indication on October 2.
非共价结合让匹妥布替尼对共价 BTK 抑制剂耐药的 C481 突变仍有效，此前定: Non-covalent binding keeps pirtobrutinib active against the C481 mutation that confers resistance to covalent BTK inhibitors; previously positioned in later lines, this trial moves it to first line.

鞘内注射的反义寡核苷酸 ulefnersen 在 FUS-ALS 中，72 周双: The intrathecal antisense oligonucleotide ulefnersen significantly beat placebo on the combined endpoint over a 72-week double-blind period in FUS-ALS, and serum neurofilament light chain fell significantly. The company did not disclose the effect size.
项目终止的连带结果。lebrikizumab 的成人哮喘三期结果不一致（一项阳性: A knock-on of programme termination. Lebrikizumab's adult asthma phase 3 results were inconsistent (one positive, one negative), so Roche stopped asthma development and this adolescent trial ended with it. The drug was later approved in atopic dermatitis.

首个可能获批的干燥综合征系统性治疗。ESSDAI 主要反映腺体外表现，口干眼干等: Possibly the first approved systemic therapy for Sjögren's. ESSDAI mainly reflects extraglandular disease; whether symptoms such as dry mouth and dry eyes improve depends on secondary endpoints.
